integrity: All displayed asymptotic constants arise from analytic Gamma mixtures and polar integration. Numerical quadrature and Monte Carlo supply corroboration rather than infinite-dimensional proof. The older simultaneous-reset gap trichotomy is credited to its published source; independent scientific review and publication-priority adjudication have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional stationary tridiagonal matrix; independent exponential entry-reset ages with identical rates; positive OU/CIR parameters; not a general-N bulk-spacing theorem, nor an exact general-N eigenvalue JPDF.
title: The \(\beta=2\) level-repulsion transition under independent matrix-entry resetting
